notes_for_editor: Directory-only tower record: no source found gives a construction date, operator, design or removal date. The Wikipedia coordinates are about 50 m from the directory point (my calculation from the two coordinate pairs). The 1934 site selection concerns the park, not the tower. A search summary claimed a 'Belair' tower on the Joplin quadrangle; it is not in the cached directory and is not used. The NPS history quotes the act renaming the park, which excepts about four acres at roads 626 and 620 'which land contains the fire tower'; the act does not tie that tower to Joplin, so it is not used. Worth checking whether that tower is the directory's Prince William Forest Park entry (FFLOS US 1950, VA 43) or this one. Access is not recorded because no source describes the tower site.
